title: Lockdown: SSO/KMS audit suppression bug causing missing tenant audit entries
creator: Maya Chen
description: Multiple enterprise customers on Private deployment reported missing audit log entries for SSO-initiated role changes and intermittent failures decrypting audit blobs. Impact: inability to prove administrative actions (audit gap) and occasional errors when retrieving historical audit payloads (KMS envelope mismatch). Root cause suspected in the private agent's role-binding cache and KMS metadata propagation path after SAML assertion refreshes.
comments: 2026-03-09 Maya Chen: Initial customer escalations aggregated via CSMs. Two paying customers provided examples where role change events are not present in audit stream for 2–5 minute windows after SSO flows. Errors include 'audit-decrypt: envelope-version-mismatch' for a subset of requests.

2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Reproduced locally in staging with short SAML assertion TTL and simultaneous role binding updates. Observed race where agent accepts new assertion, updates local role cache, but continues to write audit events with previous key-version header resulting in decryption failures when control plane attempts to unwrap later.

2026-03-11 Eng lead (Priya Rao): Scoped emergency fix — serialize role-cache invalidation and KMS metadata refresh on SSO assertion handlers. Small patch to agent to always fetch latest KMS envelope metadata before buffering/writing audit events. Start canary on staging clusters.

2026-03-12 Arjun Patel: Deployed canary to 2 private clusters (customer-like config) and validated backfilled audit events are accepted after patch. No perf regression observed for 95th percentile latencies. Added temporary alert rule (alerts:AuditDecryptErrors>5m) to PagerDuty.

2026-03-13 Customer Success (Liam O'Connor): Notified affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA for full rollout. Provided a one-off backfill plan for missing audit windows and offered assisted support for manual verification.

2026-03-14 QA (Sofia Martinez): End-to-end test added for SAML assertion rotation scenario and KMS envelope version mismatch. Regression test added to CI and flagged as required for the release branch.
2026-03-14 Arjun Patel: Preparing PR for hotpatch. Rollout plan: canary -> fast ramp -> full rollout across Dedicated/Private. Post-mortem scheduled once backfills complete.
notes: Trade-offs: added a synchronous fetch for KMS metadata during assertion handling which adds a small cold-path latency on the SSO renewal path. We accepted ~4–8ms additional tail latency in favor of guaranteeing audit correctness. Longer-term plan is to cache metadata with strong invalidation plus validating envelope signatures to avoid synchronous fetches.
next_steps: Merge PR #842 and rollout to remaining private clusters (owner: Arjun)
Run assisted backfills for affected customers and validate with CSMs (owner: Maya)
Add contract tests for KMS key-version headers and SAML propagation edge cases (owner: Priya)
Document incident and publish post-mortem with timeline and customer notifications (owner: Maya)
Plan follow-up: implement eventual async prefetch with version pinning to restore original latency characteristics (owner: Platform team)
